knowledge_gaps: Cross-fitting is underspecified: training needs user identity to select the exclusion graph, but the required diagnostic loader yields (None, sequence, positive, negative). Define how training and diagnostic examples retain user-fold assignments without changing that interface.

Inference averaging reintroduces each known training user's own transitions through K−1 fold graphs. This differs from their training exclusion graph and can introduce self-support. Compare exclusion-graph inference for known users against fold averaging, using only permitted training histories.

Reproduction requires explicit choices for fold count and assignment, transition-lift denominators, smoothing, shrinkage, score bounds, recency decay, residual initialization, temperature optimization, and checkpoint selection. Every training-position graph lookup must use only that position's causal prefix.

Filtered uniform candidate-set cross-entropy is not automatically an unbiased approximation to full-catalog softmax. Specify the intended objective, sampling distribution, duplicate handling, and behavior when fewer than 64 eligible negatives remain. Filtering all known training items also uses later training interactions, which should be disclosed as a sampling choice.

The proposed ablations combine normalization, temperature, negative count, and loss changes. They cannot isolate which change helps. Add controlled objective comparisons and a simple graph-only or fixed graph-residual baseline before more complex intent routing.

No measured validation baseline, graph coverage, runtime, or memory estimate supports the potential and difficulty ratings. Specify a budgeted trial plan within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Training margins across temperatures are not directly comparable; use fixed-candidate rank diagnostics. Twenty simulator users provide qualitative evidence rather than reliable performance estimates.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve whether fold averaging restores self-support and identify an inference protocol consistent with training-time exclusion.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation with user-cross-fitted item-transition graph features, what inference protocol avoids reintroducing a known user's own training transitions? Compare leave-user-group-out graph inference with averaging exclusion graphs, including train-inference distribution shift and target-encoding leakage.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify the objective and separate the effects of normalization, temperature, loss, and negative sampling.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec trained with cosine logits and 64 uniform negatives filtered against each user's training history, how does uncorrected candidate-set cross-entropy differ from importance-corrected sampled softmax and generalized BCE? What controlled ablations and duplicate-negative handling are recommended for sampled HR@10 evaluation?

follow_up_queries.reason: Find reproducible, efficient graph estimators and establish whether the proposed integration warrants its novelty and implementation ratings.

Include graph-only baselines, sparse-edge coverage analysis, and scalable full-catalog scoring.
